title: Hackathon Team Lead
summary: Help plan and run HackED and HackED Beta, from sponsor outreach to the day itself.
responsibilities: Attend planning meetings through the term
Tackle the issues faced in Outreach/operations/logistics and more!
Help run the event across both hackathon days
commitment: 2-3 hrs/week, plus both hackathon days (Will be assigned a shift)
questions: Which part interests you most: sponsorship, logistics, or running the event on the day?
Have you ever led or worked in a team that was organizing an overnight event?

title: Hackathon Designer
summary: Help us make the posters, social posts and merch that get people excited for HackEd
responsibilities: Make a few designs in the build up to the event as well as during
Work from a short brief and a couple of rounds of feedback
Hand off files in a format the next designer can reuse
skills: an eye for type and colour
questions: Link a design you're proud of (any format)

title: Hackathon Photographer
summary: Take photos and videos at HackEd!
responsibilities: Shoot at the upcoming HackEd Beta
Pick and lightly edit the best shots
Upload them to the club Drive within a few days
skills: Your own camera or a good phone
commitment: A few hours per day of event
questions: Link a photo or video you've taken (any subject)

title: Hackathon Team Member
summary: Help plan and run HackED and HackED Beta, from sponsor outreach to the day itself.
responsibilities: Tackle the issues faced in Outreach/operations/logistics and more!
Help run the event across both hackathon days
commitment: 1 hr/week, plus both hackathon days (Will be assigned a shift)
questions: Which part interests you most: sponsorship, logistics, or running the event on the day?
Have you ever led or worked in a team that was organizing an overnight event?

title: Hackathon Developer
summary: Help design and build the software that powers HackEd.
responsibilities: Attend planning meetings through the term
Help design web and app interfaces for hackers, sponsors, and organizers;
Document your code so the next developer can take over
Ship and fix features before HackEd Beta
Support the software during both events, including quick fixes on event weekend
questions: Walk us through a website or app you have built
HackEd needs a registration flow, a hacker dashboard, and a sponsor page. Which would you build first, and why?
What is your weekly availability for planning meetings and build time this term

title: Hackathon Mentor
summary: Be a go-to technical guide for hackers during HackEd events.
responsibilities: Hold scheduled office hours and float between team tables during the event
Help hackers scope ideas, debug code, and choose tools and APIs
Run or co-host at least one workshop or tech talk at HackEd Beta or the main HackEd
Give encouraging, practical feedback on projects during judging prep
Help first-time hackers feel welcome and included
skills: Experience in at least one language or framework
commitment: 1-2 hrs/week, plus both hackathon days (Will be assigned a shift)
questions: Tell us about a time you helped someone get unstuck on a technical problem.
Which technologies or areas could you mentor other hackers on (for example web, mobile, AI, hardware, data, or design)? Rate your confidence in each
